compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: Regression tests cover clear UI / clear non-UI / ambiguous+failed-classifier cases
- DD5: Re-invocation test confirms no double-fire of probes
- DD9: Tests cover default-only and override-applied (replace semantics) cases
- DD10: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## TDD Requirement
Write a new test file tests/skills/test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh with failing assertions.
Test approach:
- Given: SKILL.md before Phase 1 Step 2.5 insertion, prompt files don't exist yet
- When: structural grep assertions run against SKILL.md and prompt file paths
- Then: all assertions FAIL (RED) because new content has not been added yet

Test sections (all must FAIL before Task 2 commits):
1. test_ui_detection_step: grep SKILL.md for "Phase 1.*Step 2.5|UI.*intent.*detection" → FAIL
2. test_ux_probe_fired_flag: grep SKILL.md for "ux_probe_fired|ux-probe-fired" → FAIL
3. test_ux_probe_no_double_fire: grep SKILL.md for "skip.*flag|ux-probe-fired.*set|already.*fired|re.invocation" → FAIL
4. test_ui_classifier_stub: grep SKILL.md or prompt files for "BRAINSTORM_UI_CLASSIFIER_STUB" → FAIL
5. test_prompt_files_exist: test -f for all 3 prompt files (ui-keyword-trigger.md, ui-detection-classifier.md, ux-probe-set.md) → FAIL
6. test_probe_set_structure: grep ux-probe-set.md for "id.*dimension|dimension.*prompt" → FAIL (file doesn't exist)
7. test_ui_keywords_default: grep ui-keyword-trigger.md for default lexicon keywords → FAIL (file doesn't exist)
8. test_ui_keywords_override_replace: grep ui-keyword-trigger.md for "replace" or "replaces" semantics → FAIL

Follow existing brainstorm test conventions:
- Use REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel), SKILL_MD="${REPO_ROOT}/plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md"
- Use PASS/FAIL counter pattern with SECTION variable (as in test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh)
- Each section: echo "=== section_name ===", set SECTION=section_name, use pass()/fail()
- End with "ALL VALIDATIONS PASSED" or "VALIDATION FAILED" + exit code
- Set executable bit: chmod +x tests/skills/test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh

.test-index RED markers to add (5 entries):
- plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md: tests/skills/test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh [test_ui_detection_step]
- plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md: tests/skills/test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh [test_ux_probe_no_double_fire]
- plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/prompts/ui-keyword-trigger.md: tests/skills/test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh [test_prompt_files_exist]
- plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/prompts/ui-detection-classifier.md: tests/skills/test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh [test_prompt_files_exist]
- plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/prompts/ux-probe-set.md: tests/skills/test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh [test_probe_set_structure]

## Files to Modify
- tests/skills/test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh (CREATE, executable)
- .test-index (append 5 RED marker entries)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh 2>&1 | grep 'ALL VALIDATIONS PASSED'
- [ ] test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/skills/test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh
- [ ] test_ui_detection_step FAILS (RED)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh 2>&1 | grep 'FAIL: test_ui_detection_step'
- [ ] test_ux_probe_no_double_fire FAILS (RED)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh 2>&1 | grep 'FAIL: test_ux_probe_no_double_fire'
- [ ] test_prompt_files_exist FAILS (RED)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh 2>&1 | grep 'FAIL: test_prompt_files_exist'
- [ ] .test-index has RED markers for all source files
  Verify: grep -c 'test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh' .test-index | grep -qE '^[4-9]|^[1-9][0-9]'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
